document: Happy Valley Home Concierge – Policies & Procedures

sections.title: Mission Statement
sections.content: At Happy Valley Home Concierge, our mission is to deliver trusted, personalized home management and concierge services that provide peace of mind to homeowners. We strive to maintain each property with the highest standards of care, attention to detail, and local expertise.

sections.title: Scope of Services
sections.content: Happy Valley Home Concierge provides services including but not limited to:
subsections: Vendor coordination and maintenance oversight
Seasonal home preparation (opening/closing)
Staging assistance and organization
Cleaning, laundry, and linen coordination
Exterior maintenance (lawncare, snow removal, gardening)
Concierge services such as package handling, grocery stocking, and home arrival prep

sections.title: Scheduling & Service Requests
subsections: All services must be scheduled in advance through the client portal.
Emergency requests will be accommodated based on staff availability.
Recurring service schedules (weekly, bi-weekly, monthly) will be outlined in each client’s Service Agreement.
Cancellations or reschedules require at least 24 hours’ notice to avoid a cancellation fee.

sections.title: Access & Security
subsections: Clients must provide secure access (key, lockbox, or code) to the property.
Keys and access codes are stored securely and accessible only to authorized staff.
Staff must lock and secure all doors and windows before leaving a property.
No unauthorized guests or vendors are permitted on the premises.

sections.title: Vendor Management
subsections: Only approved vendors will be scheduled for property maintenance.
The concierge team may coordinate vendor access and supervision per the client’s agreement.
Clients may request specific vendors; however Happy Valley Home Concierge is not liable for third-party vendor performance.

sections.title: Billing & Payment
subsections: All services are invoiced monthly unless otherwise specified.
Payment is due within 15 days of the invoice date.
Accepted payment methods: check, ACH transfer, or credit card (3% fee applies).
A late payment fee of 1.5% per week will apply to overdue balances.

sections.title: Liability & Insurance
subsections: Happy Valley Home Concierge maintains general liability and business insurance.
Staff are background-checked.
We are not liable for damage caused by normal wear and tear of property or systems, acts of nature, vendors, contractors, or preexisting property conditions.
Client agrees to hold Service Provider harmless from any claims arising from the performance of the agreed-upon services except in cases of gross negligence or willful misconduct.

sections.title: Communication
subsections: Office Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM
After-hours calls are reserved for emergencies only.
All communication is documented via the client portal or email for quality assurance.

sections.title: Confidentiality
sections.content: All client information, access details, and property data are strictly confidential and will not be shared outside the organization without written consent.

sections.title: Cancellations & Termination
subsections: Clients may cancel ongoing services with 30 days’ written notice.
Happy Valley Home Concierge reserves the right to terminate services for non-payment, unsafe property conditions, or repeated policy violations.

sections.title: Safety & Professional Standards
subsections: Staff must wear appropriate attire and identification while on-site.
No smoking, eating, or personal activity is permitted in client homes.
All services will be conducted with professionalism, discretion, and care.

sections.title: Safety & Professional Standards
sections.content: Happy Valley Home Concierge is an independent contractor and not an employee of the Client. Nothing in this Agreement creates a partnership, joint venture, or employment relationship.

sections.title: Client Responsibilities
subsections: Maintain homeowner’s insurance coverage.
Notify Service Provider of any known hazards or maintenance concerns.
Provide at least 24 hours’ notice for schedule changes or cancellations.

sections.title: Governing Law
sections.content: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania.

sections.title: Feedback & Quality Assurance
sections.content: We value client feedback and conduct periodic check-ins to ensure satisfaction. Concerns may be directed to
subsections: info@happyvalleyconcierge.com

sections.title: Acknowledgment
sections.content: By engaging Happy Valley Home Concierge, clients acknowledge that they have reviewed and agree to the above policies and procedures.
